notes.title: Eastwynne Demo Launch!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Annndddd the demo's here 🥳🥳
[/b][/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760750/Eastwynne_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The MPQ Demo is a short side story/scenario that may or may not be canon to the main Eastwynne game. Consider this a sneak peek of what's to come. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640050/8ba5e70f06a20486bc7dfd5429b5cd3a00a45db0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]Current[/i][/b][i] [/i]Demo Features[i]:[/i][/h2][p]

Emphasis on [i][b]"current"[/b][/i], this is part 1 of the demo, and there will be multiple major updates throughout the year. Don't let the beginning style of gameplay fool you...[spoiler]More RPG elements incoming 👀👀[/spoiler][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The [i]"prologue"[/i] is completely playable ([spoiler]except for 1 path[/spoiler])[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements (Not connected to Steam. I'm sorry y'all, I couldn't get it to work 😩)[/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]Cheat codes[/spoiler][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Game Tips & Guides:[/h2][p]

I kinda, intentionally and unintentionally, made the difficulty a bit [b]"[i]questionable"[/i][/b][i](?) [/i]Personally,[i] [/i]I'm very quick to run to Google and search for guides, especially with puzzles. And if you're also like me, don't worry, I got you covered👍🏾


[url="https://wiki.eastwynne.com/mpqdemo" style="button"]MPQ Demo Wiki[/url][/p][p][/p][p]This has [b][u]everything[/u][/b] you need in case the difficulty really is questionable and/or you wanna read more about the game's content.[/p][p][/p][h3]A note on replaying...[/h3][p][/p][p]You absolutely should, and yes, I'm saying that because I want you to 😘, but also, [spoiler]how else are you gonna unlock more characters to play and learn about 'em?[/spoiler] [/p][p][/p][p][u][i][b]❗❗ Saves may break between game versions.[/b][/i][/u][/p][h2]

Future Updates:[/h2][p][/p][p]This is only part 1, the next major update should be in August/September. I'll be posting previews, updates, and early builds on Patreon/Ko-fi first.

[url="https://www.patreon.com/eastwynne" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff7300"]Patreon[/url][/p][p][url="https://ko-fi.com/theconsequenceofgods" style="button" buttoncolor="#808080"]Ko-fi[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Other Upcoming Updates:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]The separate voice audio channel controls will be added soon.[/p][/*][*][p]I will add LATAM Spanish & Brazilian Portuguese text translations ASAP.[/p][/*][*][p]I'm working on Mac and Linux (maybe?) versions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Community & Feedback:[/h2][p][/p][p]Lemme know what y'all think so far, what you like, don't like, want me to add, etc etc by submitting a report, in the reviews and/or the community. I really appreciate y'all playing the demo 💖  
[/p][h3]If you'd like to send private feedback and/or bug reports, here's the form: [url="https://forms.gle/5wgbYn9XoTkSXkFM7" style="button"]Submit Feedback & Bug Reports[/url]
[/h3][h1]

Known Issues:[/h1][list][*][p][b][i]"The play() request was interrupted by a call to pause()" [/i][/b]- This happens when the game incorrectly processes videos. It occurs randomly, and the game will crash.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]"TypeError: Cannot read property 'width' of null" [/i][/b]- This happens when the game incorrectly processes images. It can occur when [spoiler]accessing the character select screens[/spoiler], and the game will crash.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]      [/h3][h3]There's also Discord ↓[/h3]
